title: Kestrel and the Visitor
author: Juniper Vasquez
blurb: Silas Eriksen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
